newsitem.title: USA: Tracor Inc to buy Cordant Inc for $65 mln.
newsitem.headline: Tracor Inc to buy Cordant Inc for $65 mln.

text.p: Tracor Inc said Tuesday it had signed a definitive agreement with Cordant Inc to pay it $65 million in cash for all of its outstanding shares.
Tracor, which makes electronics for the defense industry, said it would pay another $15 million if Cordant performed well this year and won a major contract.
It said it expected to close the agreement by September 30.
Although the boards of both companies had approved the agreement, Cordant's shareholders as well as government regulatory agencies had yet to do so, it added.

Cordant, which makes technology to manage information for government agencies as well as the post office, is expecting revenues to total more than $150 million this year against $120 million in 1995, said Tracor.
Cordant is based in Reston, Va.
